TOTAL CATASTROPHE IMMINENT: Every Citizen Must Panic Right Now!

By Staff Reporter

The city water department announced on Tuesday that routine valve maintenance will take place along Elm Street between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM next Thursday.

Residents in the immediate two-block radius may experience temporary low water pressure during the two-hour window. Water services are expected to remain fully operational throughout the remainder of the week with no interruptions to municipal drinking supplies.

City council officials confirmed that no boil water advisory is in effect and normal operations will resume promptly at noon.
